title: Request for information record
description: One RFI, one Markdown file per record (rfis/RFI-001.md): a question raised by a gap (a red or not-measurable measure, an unmet requirement), triaged into a collection requirement (CR: the answer needs data we do not hold) or a production requirement (PR: we hold it and must produce the answer), with a last time of value (LTIOV). Raised through the records inbox (a strategy-rfi intent) and closed only by a transition: answered, no-find (a valid outcome: the search is the answer) or expired (the LTIOV sweep). 2.0 (ADR-0019): a record is identified by its `uid` (a UUIDv7) and names its `type`; every link is a uid; the numbered `id` is gone (the number a record is shown with is computed from type, parent and sibling `order`, never stored). The record-type rules of a link (which types a parent, supports, serves or raised_by may name) are the doctrine's `hierarchy` and `links`, checked by homelabnext.strategy. 1.x records are read only by `hnx records assign-uids`, which migrates them.

order.description: Optional: the sort key among its siblings (same type, same parent). Siblings without one follow, in creation (uid) order.

raised_by.description: The uid of the measure or requirement whose gap raised it.

intent.description: The strategy-rfi note that raised it, in the records tree.

reviews.description: Derived from the review events (homelabnext.reviews); never written in the record file.

uid.description: A record uid: a canonical UUIDv7 (lowercase, version 7), created with the record and never changed (ADR-0019).
